raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "one carton"
  role object "24 bottles"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "order"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "7 cartons"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "come broken"
  role subject "11 bottles"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@c constraint
  var ?total int
  var ?good int
  require ?total equal 7 times 24
  require ?good equal ?total minus 11
  task prove
  select ?good
